defective_pattern: Stripping or omitting statistical significance asterisks (* for p < .05, ** for p < .001) from correlation tables.
why_defective: Violates APA formatting standards and removes critical statistical interpretation data from correlation matrices.
observed_symptoms: Unstarred correlation coefficients in tables where p-values indicate significance.
corrective_remedy: Ensure significance asterisks (* for p < .05, ** for p < .001) are included and preserved in correlation matrices. Distinguish markdown from asterisks.

detection_heuristic.trigger_rule: Flag correlation tables lacking any asterisks.
